title: Roku launches a creator hub with licensed creator content and programming from partners like Peacock and HBO Max, alongside new FAST channels from top creators (Alex Weprin/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Alex Weprin / The Hollywood Reporter: Roku launches a creator hub with licensed creator content and programming from partners like Peacock and HBO Max, alongside new FAST channels from top creators — Roku will also expand its licensing of creator content, its content chief tells THR. — Roku is making a big bet on creator content …
contentText:
Alex Weprin / The Hollywood Reporter :

Roku launches a creator hub with licensed creator content and programming from partners like Peacock and HBO Max, alongside new FAST channels from top creators   —  Roku will also expand its licensing of creator content, its content chief tells THR.  —  Roku is making a big bet on creator content …
